title: K-Pop Demon Hunters Jinu Action Figure - Sealed New, PVC
categoryName: Collectibles:Collectible Figures & Supplies:Collectible Figures Sealed Blind Packs
descriptionText: The K-Pop Demon Hunters Jinu Figure is a standard size collectible made of PVC material. This item features the character Jinu from the K-Pop Demon Hunter franchise, designed in a multicolor anime style. Released in 2025 by Sensibling Corp., this action figure is part of the Action Figure Collection series and comes in its original packaging. The figure depicts Jinu in a dynamic pose, making it a must-have for fans of the show and collectors of anime-themed items.
